author: GamingBolt
description:
Marvel’s Wolverine is almost here, and it’s definitely a title worthy of a character who hasn’t been in as many video games as we’d have liked him to be. That’s changed now, though, as Logan gets his own little adventure with us in tow, and it’s a doozy. With that being said, you’re probably going to have an easier time with it all if you keep a few of the things we’ve discovered during our time with the game in mind.

Join us as we attempt to make your time with Marvel’s Wolverine an experience where you’re enjoying cutting loose as the world-weary warrior without worrying too much about everything else. There’s a lot of ground to cover before you begin the adventure, so dive in before it's here.
title: 15 Things Marvel's Wolverine Doesn't Tell You

author: GamingBolt
description:
Marvel’s Wolverine has been put through its paces before it makes its way to you. But if you’ve been waiting to see what the critics are saying before you fork over your cash, you might be in a bit of a pickle right about now. How can a game be praised so highly and yet have a few people rating it as low as they have? What’s gone wrong for a title that looked like it was getting almost everything about good old Logan right?

We’ve been keeping tabs, and have a few things to say about the situation. Our claws are out to stick up for a game that we believe deserves a fair shot at achieving its ambitions. Join us as we cut through the noise surrounding an experience that does exactly what it says on the label.
title: Why Is Marvel's Wolverine So Divisive?
